text: Usage went up on the AWS platform service Amazon CloudWatch for resource /acme/prod/app starting on 31 August 2026, which added an extra cost so far of $532.13. The daily cost jumped from the usual_daily_cost of $6.06 to $46.06 when detected, and the incident ended on 12 September 2026. Review the platform usage for Amazon CloudWatch to prevent future cost spikes.
